subject: Declaring column name externally to ezAnova/ezStats

messages.author: 15035207a92ad0f5
messages.subject: Declaring column name externally to ezAnova/ezStats
parts:
Hi all,
I'm new to this, but can't for the life of me figure out a way to pass an external variable in as a column name. Is it even possible?

So if colName = "column5"
Then I want to run an ezANOVA/ezStats(data=dframe, dv=colName, wid=.(ID), within=.(g1,g2), etc)
The idea is to then be able to manipulate the call based on what is in the variable

The issue is I can't get the variable contents into the function call.
I've tried assigns, substitutes, all sorts of things.. each time, whatever I put in the dv= part gets spat out as "colName is not a variable in the data frame provided."
I even tried embedding the entire "dv = .(col5)" into the variable and getting it to parse in but it won't take that either.

Any ideas?
Thanks

messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] Declaring column name externally to ezAnova/ezStats
parts:
I presume you're trying to include ezANOVA/ezStats inside a loop that
is iterating over a set of dv columns; this should work:

dvCols = c('column1','column2','column3')
for(colName in dvCols){
eval(parse(text=paste('results =
ezANOVA(data=dframe,dv=',colName,',wid=ID,within=.(g1,g2))')))
#do something with results here...

}
